study type: Retrospective review of randomized controlled trials
exposure: Acupuncture intervention details (acupoint selection, acupuncturist ability, needling response, treatment frequency, placebo control setting)
cohort: The study analyzed 33 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) from the 2011 SCI database, focusing on those reporting negative results or placebo effects.
finding: The primary basis for negative results or placebo effects in international clinical trials on acupuncture is not methodological quality but noncompliance with essential requirements of acupuncture theory regarding clinical manipulation details.
